description: Round 4 structural entry+exit redesign of GaganEA.mq5 (v2.11 -> v2.12) to attack the negative edge (PF < 1, avg loss 1.23 > avg win 0.70). TWO coherent structural changes: (1) ENTRY QUALITY - replace the low-conviction 'pattern zoo' gate with a confluence gate: HTF+CTF trend agreement (kept) AND an ATR-based volatility-regime filter (skip dead/hostile chop) AND an EMA-pullback-and-resume trigger with RSI confirmation (don't buy overbought / don't sell oversold) AND an optional session/hour filter to skip illiquid + rollover hours. (2) EXIT / REWARD:RISK - add optional ATR-based dynamic SL and ATR-scaled targets so stops/targets scale with volatility and the core target enforces reward:risk >= ~1.5, so the average winner can structurally exceed the average loser. Keep risk conservative (Risk_Percent default 1.0, concurrent cap, real protective stops). This is a single coherent unit of work on ONE file plus an ITERATION_LOG.md entry. It is an EXPERIMENT: no performance can be measured in-sandbox; do NOT invent numbers. CRITICAL: the 11 tuner-managed inputs (Risk_Percent, Min_EMA_Distance, Min_Trade_Distance, StopLoss_Pips, T1_Pips, T2_Pips, T3_Pips, T1_ClosePercent, T2_ClosePercent, Entry_Cooldown_Bars, Max_Concurrent_Positions) MUST keep their exact names, types, and single-line `input TYPE Name = value;` form or the tuner regex + its 38 unittests break. Add NEW inputs only; do not rename/remove existing ones.
steps: VERSION BUMP: In GaganEA.mq5 change every '2.11' to '2.12' at: the header comment banner (lines ~2, ~5), #property copyright "GaganEA v2.11" (line ~15), #property version "2.11" (line ~16), the OnInit Print ("GaganEA v2.11 initialized...", line ~286), the OnDeinit Print ("GaganEA v2.12 removed...", line ~308), and the dashboard title ObjLabel(lbl+"title", " GaganEA v2.11", ...) (line ~1431). Also change the EA_Comment default input from "GaganEA" to "GaganEA v2.12" (input string EA_Comment, line ~183). Update the header comment banner to briefly describe the Round 4 structural change (confluence entry + ATR dynamic SL/TP) instead of the Round 2 text. Do NOT add non-ASCII characters.

NEW INPUTS (add in clearly-labelled new input groups; do NOT touch the 11 tuner names): Add group '=== ATR VOLATILITY / DYNAMIC SL-TP (Round 4) ==='. Add: input int ATR_Period = 14; input ENUM_TIMEFRAMES ATR_Timeframe = PERIOD_M5; input bool Use_ATR_Regime_Filter = true; input double ATR_Min_Points = 150.0 (min ATR in POINTS to allow trading - skip dead chop); input double ATR_Max_Points = 4000.0 (max ATR in POINTS - skip hostile spikes; generous default); input bool Use_ATR_Dynamic_SLTP = true; input double ATR_SL_Mult = 1.5 (SL distance = ATR_SL_Mult * ATR); input double ATR_TP_Mult = 2.5 (core target distance = ATR_TP_Mult * ATR, giving R:R ~1.67). NOTE all ATR distances are in PRICE derived from the ATR indicator value (which is in price units); convert to points only for the regime-filter comparison (atr/_Point). Add group '=== ENTRY CONFLUENCE (Round 4) ==='. Add: input bool Use_Confluence_Entry = true (master switch for the new gate); input bool Require_Pattern_Confirm = false (when true the legacy DetectBullish/BearishPattern must ALSO fire as a secondary confirmation); input int RSI_Entry_Period = 14; input double RSI_Buy_Max = 68.0 (do NOT buy if RSI above this = overbought); input double RSI_Sell_Min = 32.0 (do NOT sell if RSI below this = oversold); input int Pullback_Lookback = 6 (bars to look back for the EMA pullback-and-resume). Add group '=== SESSION / TIME FILTER (Round 4) ==='. Add: input bool Use_Session_Filter = true; input int Session_Start_Hour = 7 (server hour, inclusive); input int Session_End_Hour = 20 (server hour, exclusive); input bool Skip_Rollover_Hour = true (skip the hour around broker rollover); input int Rollover_Hour = 0 (server hour to skip when Skip_Rollover_Hour). Use int hour inputs, ENUM_TIMEFRAMES where noted, bool for switches. Keep every new input name distinct from the 11 tuner names (do NOT reuse RSI_Period which already exists for the reversal exit - use RSI_Entry_Period).

GLOBAL HANDLES: add `int atr_handle;` and `int rsi_entry_handle;` to the GLOBAL VARIABLES block near the other handle ints (line ~150). In OnInit, after the existing handle creation, create them ONLY when needed: `atr_handle = iATR(_Symbol, ATR_Timeframe, ATR_Period);` guard `if(atr_handle==INVALID_HANDLE){ Print(...); return INIT_FAILED; }` (create whenever Use_ATR_Regime_Filter||Use_ATR_Dynamic_SLTP). Create `rsi_entry_handle = iRSI(_Symbol, Trade_Timeframe, RSI_Entry_Period, PRICE_CLOSE);` guarded, when Use_Confluence_Entry. Initialize both to INVALID_HANDLE at declaration is not possible for globals, so set them in OnInit before use and default-guard. In OnDeinit release them: `if(atr_handle!=INVALID_HANDLE) IndicatorRelease(atr_handle);` and same for rsi_entry_handle, following the existing IndicatorRelease pattern.

ATR HELPER: add a helper `double GetATR()` that does `double a[]; ArraySetAsSeries(a,true); if(atr_handle==INVALID_HANDLE) return 0; if(CopyBuffer(atr_handle,0,0,2,a) < 2) return 0; return a[0];` (returns ATR in PRICE units, 0 if unavailable). Guard all callers against a 0 return (treat 0 as 'data not ready' -> skip trading / fall back to fixed SL).

ENTRY REWRITE in OpenTrade(): keep the existing structure (CopyBuffer emaHTF/emaCTF guards, bid/ask, htfBull/htfBear/ctfBull/ctfBear, dist>=Min_EMA_Distance farEnough, the concurrent-cap check, and the Entry_Cooldown_Bars throttle - all UNCHANGED). Then, before the BUY/SELL blocks, compute confluence gates: (a) SESSION: if Use_Session_Filter, get server hour via TimeCurrent()/MqlDateTime; if hour < Session_Start_Hour or hour >= Session_End_Hour -> return; if Skip_Rollover_Hour and hour==Rollover_Hour -> return. (b) ATR REGIME: if Use_ATR_Regime_Filter, atr=GetATR(); if atr<=0 -> return (data not ready); double atrPts=atr/_Point; if atrPts < ATR_Min_Points or atrPts > ATR_Max_Points -> return. (c) RSI: read rsi_entry via a guarded CopyBuffer(rsi_entry_handle,0,0,3,rsiArr) (skip if Use_Confluence_Entry false). Then gate each side: For BUY require htfBull && ctfBull && farEnough AND (if Use_Confluence_Entry: an EMA-pullback-and-resume = within the last Pullback_Lookback bars price dipped toward/below emaCTF and the most recent closed bar closed back above emaCTF, i.e. a resume; AND rsi_entry[0] <= RSI_Buy_Max) AND (if Require_Pattern_Confirm: DetectBullishPattern()>0). When Use_Confluence_Entry is false, fall back to the legacy behavior (DetectBullishPattern()>0) so the EA still works with the new gate disabled. Mirror for SELL (pullback toward/above emaCTF then close back below; rsi_entry[0] >= RSI_Sell_Min; DetectBearishPattern()). Keep DistanceCheckOK(ORDER_TYPE_BUY/SELL) as the final stacking gate. Implement the pullback-and-resume as a small helper (e.g. bool BullPullbackResume(double &emaCtfBuf[]) / BearPullbackResume) that copies emaCTF and closes for Pullback_Lookback+2 bars with guarded Copy calls, or inline with guarded CopyClose + CopyBuffer(ema_ctf_handle,...). Keep it simple and guarded.

EXIT / DYNAMIC SL-TP in OpenTrade(): when Use_ATR_Dynamic_SLTP AND atr>0, compute the protective stop from ATR instead of the fixed StopLoss_Pips: for BUY sl = ask - ATR_SL_Mult*atr; set a real take-profit tp = ask + ATR_TP_Mult*atr (this is the NEW structural core target enforcing R:R = ATR_TP_Mult/ATR_SL_Mult ~= 1.67). For SELL sl = bid + ATR_SL_Mult*atr; tp = bid - ATR_TP_Mult*atr. Normalize sl/tp with NormalizeDouble(x,_Digits) and respect SYMBOL_TRADE_STOPS_LEVEL (if the broker min-stop distance is larger than the computed distance, widen to the min). Pass tp into trade.Buy/ trade.Sell (currently tp=0). When Use_ATR_Dynamic_SLTP is false OR atr<=0, keep the EXISTING behavior exactly: sl = Use_StopLoss ? ask - StopLoss_Pips*_Point : 0 and tp=0 (tiered T1/T2/T3 partial-close logic still runs and is UNCHANGED). This makes the ATR path additive and reversible. IMPORTANT: the tiered ManageTargets T1/T2/T3 logic stays as-is; the ATR tp is a hard broker-side target that lets a runner reach a real R:R>=1.5 even if the partials bank early. Document in a comment that when ATR SL/TP is on, the T1/T2/T3 points still act as partial-close triggers layered under the ATR stop/target.

Include: Hypothesis (the 52% near-random win rate + avg-loss>avg-win means the ENTRY edge is negative and losers structurally bigger; confluence entry should raise signal quality and the ATR-scaled SL/TP + real R:R>=1.5 core target should make winners structurally >= losers; ATR regime + session filters should stop trading in chop/illiquid hours). Change made (list EXACT new inputs and the entry/exit logic changes, note the 11 tuner inputs are untouched, note ATR path is additive/reversible via Use_ATR_Dynamic_SLTP + Use_Confluence_Entry switches). Intended effect (per-mechanism: fewer higher-quality entries -> win rate/PF up; ATR SL/TP -> avg win >= avg loss; regime/session -> less chop bleed; DD stays conservative via unchanged Risk_Percent/cap/real stops). What to watch next backtest (PF crossing 1.0, avg win vs avg loss ratio, relative DD < 15% target, trade count not collapsing to near-zero, whether ATR_Min_Points is too strict). NO invented performance numbers - explicitly state compile+backtest are pending the user's Windows MT5 run.
